prs.cluster_pick_reason: #3063 detects collisions via `str(message.id)`, which collapses JSON-RPC's distinct integer id 1 and string id "1" into the same key (causing false-positive 409s on legitimate concurrent requests with different id types) and doesn't guard against a string id equal to the `_GET_stream` sentinel colliding with the standalone GET stream slot. #3221 replaces this with a type-preserving `_request_stream_key()` helper (`i:`/`s:` prefixes) that implements the same duplicate-in-flight-id rejection while also fixing both of those edge cases, making it a strict superset of #3063's fix.

clusters.pick_reason: #2478 fixes the bug generically at the MCPError base class via a new _restore_mcp_error dispatcher that special-cases UrlElicitationRequiredError.from_error(...) and falls back to from_error_data(...) for every other subclass, so it reproduces #2555's exact reconstruction behavior for UrlElicitationRequiredError while also covering any other current/future MCPError subclass with a non-default constructor. members.author: Zelys-DFKH

clusters.pick_reason: #3063 detects collisions via `str(message.id)`, which collapses JSON-RPC's distinct integer id 1 and string id "1" into the same key (causing false-positive 409s on legitimate concurrent requests with different id types) and doesn't guard against a string id equal to the `_GET_stream` sentinel colliding with the standalone GET stream slot. #3221 replaces this with a type-preserving `_request_stream_key()` helper (`i:`/`s:` prefixes) that implements the same duplicate-in-flight-id rejection while also fixing both of those edge cases, making it a strict superset of #3063's fix.
